svg.title: Lord of Illusionary Success: Seven of Cups · Venus in Scorpio · Netzach (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Venus above the painting and Scorpio below, as Book T places them: "Above and below are the symbols of the Decanate Venus and Scorpio."
